item.title: How non-player characters in 'Grand Theft Auto VI' help create its big world
item.description: In video games, "barks" are short lines of dialogue given to various characters in the world. Grand Theft Auto VI proves how this kind of dialogue contributes to an immersive world.
item.content:encoded: In video games, "barks" are short lines of dialogue given to various characters in the world. Grand Theft Auto VI proves how this kind of dialogue contributes to an immersive world.

item.title: How the Steadicam sprinted up the stairs along with Rocky
item.description: A new movie about the making of Sylvester Stallone's 1976 film Rocky opens nationwide this week. It made him a star and helped revolutionize cinematography — including technology still used today.

item.description: Their new album makes the case for rappers Elucid and billy woods as an era-defining team: attuned to a dark sociopolitical moment, yet powered by a humans-first creative ethic.

item.title: Judges have put Trump's arch and golf course on hold, but only for a matter of days
item.description: A federal judge has twice delayed construction of Trump's arch. Another is keeping East Potomac Park open. The proposed golf course redesign got mixed feedback from a federal arts panel on Thursday.

item.title: The midterms were the largest win for either party in 50 years
item.description: Some 56% of people cast votes for Democrats in House races, compared to 42% who voted Republican. That 14-point spread is the widest win for either party in 50 years, since after Watergate.

item.title: The U.N.'s top court rules Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya
item.description: The International Court of Justice found that Myanmar security forces "acted with genocidal intent" against the Rohingya during military operations in the northern Rakhine state in 2017.
